blocks.text: NaOH solution ki molarity is molarity equation se nikalein:

items: V₁ = istemal hue acid ka volume
n₁ = balanced chemical equation mein acid ke moles
V₂ = istemal hue base solution ka volume
n₂ = balanced chemical equation mein base ke moles

blocks.text: Diye gaye base solution ki molarity ____ M hai.

blocks.caption: Dhone aur reading lene ke rules
rows: distilled water se dhoyein, phir us NaOH se jo is mein liya jayega
distilled water se dhoyein, phir us HCl se jo is mein liya jayega; funnel hatayein; hawa ka bulbula nikalein
anti-parallax card ya safed kaghaz; initial aur final; kam az kam teen concordant readings 0.1 cm3 ke andar

blocks.prompt: a) Titration mein indicator aur end point ki definition likhein.
blocks.explanation: Indicator woh substance hai jo rang badal kar batata hai ke reaction complete ho gaya (jaise phenolphthalein). End point woh moment hai jab indicator rang badalta hai; is titration mein gulabi rang ghayab hota hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Concordant reading ka kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: Dohrai gayi titrations ki woh readings jo aapas mein 0.1 cm³ ke andar milti hon. Kam az kam teen concordant readings li jati hain taake result sahi ho.

items: Titration: anjaan solution ko standard solution se end point tak milaya jata hai; indicator rang badal kar end point batata hai.
Phenolphthalein: pH kam hone par gulabi se be-rang; is titration mein end point par gulabi rang ghayab hota hai.
NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O; M₁V₁/n₁ = M₂V₂/n₂ se base ki molarity M₂ nikalti hai.
